Home/Replacement parts/Roborock Q5 Max+

Roborock Q5 Max+ replacement parts.

For the U.S. Roborock Q5 Max+ robot, model Q50ULE, with Auto-Empty Dock model AED06LRR or AED07LRR. Match the labels on your robot and dock before choosing parts.

Check the variant: The Q5 Max+ uses two main rollers and is vacuum-only. Q5+ has a single-bristle brush, Q5 Pro+ adds a detachable mop, and Q10 S5+ has its own brush and VibraRise mop system. Check the exact model in each listing. Dock bags are for the Q5 Max+ Auto-Empty Dock, not the robot's dustbin. The dual-roller kit is third-party; the other linked parts are Roborock-branded.

Roborock Q5 Max+ replacement dual roller brush kit

One dual roller brush, six side brushes, four filters and two cleaning tools, as stated in the listing.

View dual-roller brush kit on Amazon ↗

Fit: The Amazon listing explicitly includes Q5 Max+ and describes one dual roller brush. This is a third-party mixed-parts kit, not an original Roborock brush; DustMigo has not physically tested its fit or durability.

Replace when: Roborock recommends checking and cleaning the main brushes every 2 weeks and replacing them every 6–12 months, or sooner if worn or damaged.

Before buying: Confirm Q5 Max+ in the selected listing and make sure the kit shows the dual-roller brush. Do not choose a single-roller Q5/Q5+ kit. The kit also includes side brushes and filters; compare those parts with the robot before installing.

Roborock Q5 Max+ replacement filters

Two washable filters.

View filters on Amazon ↗

Fit: The Roborock-branded Amazon listing explicitly names Q5 Max+. These washable filters fit the robot dustbin; they are separate from the disposable bag in the dock.

Replace when: Roborock says to clean the washable filter every week and replace it every 6–12 months, or sooner if damaged or still clogged after cleaning.

Before buying: Confirm Q5 Max+ and the two-filter pack in the listing. Rinse with clean water only and let the filter dry completely for at least 24 hours before reinstalling.

Fit: Roborock's U.S. accessories catalog lists this black side-brush family for Q5 Max+. The Amazon listing is Roborock-branded and describes the two-piece black brush set, though its displayed title does not name Q5 Max+ individually.

Roborock Q5 Max+ replacement dock dust bags

Six disposable 2.5 L dust bags.

View dock bags on Amazon ↗

Fit: The Roborock-branded Amazon listing explicitly names Q5 Max+ and states 2.5 L bags. Roborock identifies the Q5 Max+ dock bag as a 2.5 L E12-rated bag. These fit the Auto-Empty Dock, not the washable filter slot in the robot.

Replace when: Replace the dock bag when full or as required. Roborock says actual emptying intervals depend on use and environment.

Before buying: Confirm Q5 Max+ and the six-bag option, and match your dock label to AED06LRR or AED07LRR. The Q5 Max without the plus sign does not include this Auto-Empty Dock configuration.

EXACT-MODEL FIT

What is shared, and what needs checking?

U.S. robot and dock
Roborock's U.S. manual identifies robot model Q50ULE and Auto-Empty Dock models AED06LRR and AED07LRR. Match the label on your robot and dock before ordering.
Main rollers and model variants
The Q5 Max+ uses the DuoRoller system with two main rollers. Roborock lists Q5+ with a single-bristle brush and Q5 Pro+ with a detachable mop. Q10 S5+ has a separate brush and VibraRise mop system. The Q5 Max+ bag listing also names Q10 S5+, but shared dock bags do not prove shared robot-part fit. This guide is not for the Q5 Max without the plus sign; check the exact model in every listing.
Robot filter and dock bag
The washable filter belongs in the robot dustbin. The 2.5 L disposable bag belongs in the Auto-Empty Dock; the bag is not a robot filter.
Mopping parts
The Q5 Max+ is a vacuum-only model, so this guide does not include mop pads. Q5 Pro+ is a separate model with different listed features and should be checked independently.
Original and third-party parts
The filter, side brushes, dock bags and robot listing are Roborock-branded. The dual-roller kit is third-party and its fit and durability have not been physically tested by DustMigo.
CLEAN FIRST, REPLACE WHEN NEEDED

Roborock Q5 Max+ maintenance intervals

The manufacturer’s published care guidance for this model gives these intervals. Wear and your cleaning routine can change when a part needs replacement; follow the replacement manufacturer’s care instructions too.

Roborock Q5 Max+ cleaning and replacement intervals
PartCleanReplace
DuoRoller main brushesEvery 2 weeks6–12 months
Side brushMonthly3–6 months
Washable robot filterEvery week6–12 months
Auto-Empty Dock bagDisposableWhen full or as required

Switch off the robot before servicing the brushes. Rinse the washable filter with clean water only and let it dry for at least 24 hours before reinstalling. Replace the disposable dock bag when full.

Before you order

How do I identify the U.S. Roborock Q5 Max+?

The U.S. manual lists robot model Q50ULE and Auto-Empty Dock model AED06LRR or AED07LRR. Check both labels, especially if you are ordering dock bags.

Does the Q5 Max+ use one main brush or two?

It uses Roborock's DuoRoller system with two main rollers. Choose a listing that explicitly identifies Q5 Max+ and a dual-roller brush; single-roller Q5/Q5+ kits are a different fit.

Are Q5 Max+ replacement filters the same as dock bags?

No. The washable filter sits in the robot dustbin. Disposable 2.5 L bags sit inside the Auto-Empty Dock.

Does the Q5 Max+ need mop pads?

No. The Q5 Max+ is a vacuum-only model. Q5 Pro+ is a separate model, so check its own parts and compatibility before ordering.

Which linked items are original Roborock parts?

The washable filters, black side brushes and dock bags are Roborock-branded listings. The dual-roller brush kit is third-party and has not been physically tested by DustMigo.
